name: Automatic Egg Incubator
desc: Fully automated 60-egg incubator featuring hands-free temperature/humidity management and scheduled egg rotation.
overview: The Automatic Egg Incubator (60-Egg Model) provides a fully automated hatching environment for chickens, ducks, quails, and more. It features hands-free temperature and humidity management, alongside an integrated automatic egg-rolling tray that simulates natural broody hen behavior to ensure uniform heat distribution and significantly higher hatch rates.
features: Hands-Free Operation: Fully automated temperature, humidity management, and scheduled egg rotation minimize manual labor and human error.
Higher Hatch Rates: The integrated automatic rolling tray ensures uniform heat distribution and prevents embryos from sticking to the shell wall.
Ideal Batch Size: 60-egg capacity provides the optimal balance for small-scale breeders, homesteaders, and commercial poultry startups.
Affordable Investment: High-yield automation delivered at an accessible ₹6,000 price point for quick return on investment.

detailedSpecs.label: Target Application
detailedSpecs.value: Automatic Poultry Egg Hatching (Chicken, Duck, Quail, etc.)

detailedSpecs.value: Automatic Egg-Rolling Tray (simulates natural broody hen behavior)
